items.summary: In the backend Motoko actor (backend/main.mo), ensure the stored admin principal is exactly 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae'. The isCallerAdmin function (or equivalent authorization check) must compare caller.toText() against this principal. If the admin principal is held in a stable variable, update its initialization default and provide a migration path in backend/migration.mo so the live canister state is overwritten with this value on the next upgrade without losing other data. The error message 'Keine Berechtigung: Nur Admins können Kollektionen verwalten.' must no longer appear for this principal.

In the frontend hook useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout, ensure the hardcoded fallback admin principal is 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae' and that principal comparisons trim whitespace and normalize to lowercase on both sides. Add or confirm console.log output showing: (1) the current caller's principal text, (2) the hardcoded fallback principal, (3) the result of the backend isCallerAdmin call, so that any remaining mismatch on the live site can be diagnosed immediately.
